_about: cl1: poses for Encounter's step 3 cue events, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/cl1.mjs. Played by AnimFighter (step 3 cues and ground contact). Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

cl.hold.tie_reach._orig: the reach for the collar: one hand out to take it, the other held up at his own chest, the weight coming forward

cl.hold.seat._orig: the tie-up at an even grip: one hand at the side of the collar and the other at the elbow, the heads apart, the feet set

cl.hold.ahead._orig: a grip a step ahead: the weight forward, the shoulders over the hands, the rival being walked back

cl.hold.behind._orig: a grip a step behind: upright and pushed back on the heels, the hands holding on

cl.hold.pummel_l._orig: the pummel on the left: the free hand swimming in low under his arm for the better grip

cl.hold.pummel_r._orig: the pummel on the right: the other hand swimming in low for the better grip

cl.hold.brace._orig: the brace: low and wide, the elbows in, the head down, waiting out a stronger grip

cl.hold.pin._orig: the pin: the shoulder leading in, one hand at the collar side and the forearm along the shoulder, never across the throat, the hips apart, the feet driving

cl.hold.pin_brace._orig: the pinned body bracing: his back to the surface, both feet bearing weight, both hands up and pushing against the hold, struggling

cl.hold.carry._orig: the carry: leaning into the drive with one hand at the collar and one at the waist, the legs pushing

cl.hold.strain._orig: the carry at its cap: low and straining, the head down, the hands holding on

cl.hold.whiff._orig: a refused grip: the hand closing on nothing, over-reached, the weight a step too far forward

cl.hold.apart._orig: pushing apart: both open hands pressing off, the weight going back
